# Portfolio Project - Copilot Instructions

## Project Stack
- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion (animations)
- @tsparticles/react (hero section electrical sparks effect)

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all code
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling (no UI libraries like Shadcn)
- Use Framer Motion for standard animations and transitions
- Use @tsparticles/react specifically for the electrical sparks effect in hero section
- No database setup (portfolio showcases existing projects with database implementations)
- Keep animations subtle and professional
- Follow modern Next.js App Router conventions
